name: simset-therm-002
description: Identify the thermostat/fix that ensures proper canonical (or isothermal-isobaric) ensemble sampling with correct fluctuation statistics (e.g., heat capacity, volume fluctuations) during production runs.

examples.input:
units real
atom_style atomic
read_data data.material
pair_style lj/cut 10.0
pair_coeff * * 0.238 3.405

velocity all create 300.0 54321 mom yes

# Which thermostat/fix is most appropriate to use for production sampling with correct ensemble statistics?
# examples: "fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 100.0 iso 1.0 1.0 1000.0"
# options (single token): berendsen, npt, langevin, nve
